title: BigQuery
description: A Google BigQuery project's datasets, read over the BigQuery API as a service account that may only read.

fields.label: Project

fields.label: Location

setup.title: A service account that may only read
setup.say:
Superatom only reads. Give it a service account of its own with two roles: BigQuery Data Viewer (read the tables) and BigQuery Job User (run queries) — nothing that writes.

In the [Google Cloud console](https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/serviceaccounts): IAM & Admin → Service accounts → Create service account, name it superatom-reader, grant it those two roles; then open it → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON. Or run the commands below (name your project). Paste the key file here.

copy.label: A read-only service account and its key (gcloud)
copy.value:
gcloud iam service-accounts create superatom-reader --project=YOUR_PROJECT --display-name="Superatom (read only)"
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding YOUR_PROJECT --member="serviceAccount:superatom-reader@YOUR_PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/bigquery.dataViewer"
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding YOUR_PROJECT --member="serviceAccount:superatom-reader@YOUR_PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/bigquery.jobUser"
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create superatom-key.json --iam-account=superatom-reader@YOUR_PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com

fix.when: not JSON|not a service account key|private key could not be read
fix.say: That is not a service account's JSON key. Make one (the service account → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON) and paste the whole file.
Google refused the key: it was deleted or disabled, or the service account was. Make a new JSON key and paste it.
The BigQuery API is not turned on in this project. Turn it on (APIs & Services → Library → BigQuery API → Enable), wait a minute, and check again.
Signed in, but the service account may not run queries. Give it the role BigQuery Job User (roles/bigquery.jobUser) in {project}.
There is no project {project}, or the service account cannot see it. Give the project's ID (not its name), as the console shows it.

setup.title: Which datasets
setup.say: Leave it empty to read every dataset in the project, or name the ones to read (sales, finance). The check counts the tables it may read there.

fix.say: Signed in, but the service account may read no table there. Give it BigQuery Data Viewer (roles/bigquery.dataViewer) on the project or on those datasets.
There is no dataset by one of those names in the project. Names are case-sensitive: copy them as the console shows them.
